title: With a short screen, Notification about removing an applet is partially off screen while "Show Panel Configuration" is active
line: On short screens, notifications now stay fully visible instead of being pushed off the top of the screen by the panel settings dialog.
explanation: positionPopups() in the notifications applet moved a popup above (or below) an obstructing dialog such as Panel Settings whenever they intersected, without checking that the new position was still on screen. On a short screen (1280x720 logical) the Panel Settings dialog is so tall that the 'Widget Removed' notification ended up with its header cut off by the top edge. The popup now only dodges the dialog if it still fits inside the screen; otherwise it keeps its normal position and overlaps the dialog, as it already does with the Add Widgets sidebar.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: Don't dodge a dialog if that pushes popups off screen

On short screens, the popup moved past an obstructing dialog, like the
panel configuration, even when it then ended up partially off screen.
Only dodge the dialog if the popup still fits, otherwise overlap it.

BUG: 488538

media.caption: Master, 1280x720, Panel Settings open, Peek at Desktop removed: the notification dodges the dialog and its header is cut off at the top.
With the fix, same steps: the notification stays at its normal place over the dialog, fully visible.
